class Point
  attr_reader :x, :y

  def initialize(x, y)
    @x = x
    @y = y
  end

  def self.from_array(array)
    new(array[0], array[1])
  end

  def to_h
    { x: x, y: y }
  end

  def ==(other)
    other.is_a?(Point) && x == other.x && y == other.y
  end

  def hash
    [x, y].hash
  end
end
